unmet_demand.want: To see the app's own menus and contents — what is inside it and what it offers
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He was shown a client's workout screens playing back, and accepted that as sufficient, but the specific thing he asked for on the primary call was never supplied: 'to see app, Carlos' menu, what is inside and what is offering' and 'You have this empty app, only send me a screenshot.' No neutral or empty-state view of the product exists to send. Recording it because he settled rather than got it, and the next prospect who asks may not settle.
